craft_notes: Sthāyin: Resting in dependence (nirvṛti). Kept (triple dash is the gait); no change but breath. Rejected: smoothing the dashes — they ARE the music. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: Through keep, kindle, kill, in this triple world's errands here —
sole indeed, Lord, thy sway — loose — thou eyest the web.
l4.sanskrit_cite: sthityutpattilayair lokatrayasyopakriyāsv iha ekaiveśa bhavacchaktiḥ svatantraṃ tantram īkṣase

reads_against.argmap: By maintenance, origin, dissolutions, in services of three worlds here. → Your alone free power oversees the three-world loom.
c1_essence: Lone free might watches the triple weave.
reads_against.l2: Through keeping, kindling, killing, in this triple world's errands — yours only, lord, the might — unbound — you watch the weave.
l3: Through keep, kindle, kill, in triple-earth's errands here —
sole indeed, Lord, thy sway — loose — thou eyest the web.
reads_against.t1: By maintenance, origin, dissolutions, in services of three worlds here — alone indeed, O lord, your power — free — the loom you oversee.
